kv5.6:1.4: nanu paṭhavīkasiṇasamāpattiṃ samāpannassa atthī ñāṇaṃ, paṭhavīkasiṇañca sammutisaccamhi’ti.
kv5.6:1.6: hañci paṭhavīkasiṇasamāpattiṃ samāpannassa atthī ñāṇaṃ ‘paṭhavīkasiṇañca sammutisaccamhi, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv5.6:2.6: gilānapaccaya bhesajjaparikkhāraṃ dadantassa atthī ñāṇaṃ, gilānapaccaya bhesajjaparikkhāro ca sammutisaccamhi’ti.
kv5.6:2.8: hañci gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ dadantassa atthī ñāṇaṃ, gilānapaccayabhesajja parikkhāro ca sammutisaccamhi, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv5.6:3.3: tena ñāṇena dukkhaṃ parijānāti. samudayaṃ pajahati, nirodhaṃ sacchikarotī, maggaṃ bhāvetī’ti.
